cohort: 193 singleton infants born between 25+0 and 27+6 weeks of gestation in breech presentation, alive on arrival in the delivery room, and weighing at least 500 grams at birth
finding: Although not statistically significant after adjustment, planned vaginal delivery for breech presentation at extremely preterm gestational age (25+0 to 27+6 weeks) was associated with a higher risk of neonatal death, particularly in the delivery room.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery in breech presentation was associated with a higher risk of death in the delivery room compared to planned cesarean delivery.
